# Mostik

> Mostik (Мостик) is an unofficial, open-source desktop client for Yandex Telemost chats (Яндекс Телемост, Yandex 360). It runs on Linux (AppImage) and Windows (installer), is written in Rust with Tauri 2 and Leptos, and is MIT-licensed. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by Yandex LLC.

Mostik talks to the undocumented protocol of the Telemost web client (HTTP RPC plus the Xiva WebSocket) and marks every request with `Mostik/<version>` in the `User-Agent`. Login goes through Yandex ID, including corporate SSO; only the session cookies are stored, in the system keyring (Secret Service on Linux, Credential Manager on Windows). Features: channels, groups, Telemost meeting chats, broadcast channels, direct messages, threads, editing, reactions, custom emoji shared between Mostik users through a hidden service chat, file and image upload, live updates, notifications, tray icon, statuses, search over loaded messages, light and dark themes, Russian and English UI, one-click updates from GitHub releases (signed, checked by the Tauri updater). Calls open in their own window like Slack huddles: on Windows a WebView2 window, on Linux an installed Chromium-based browser in app mode with a throwaway profile (WebKitGTK has no WebRTC), falling back to the default browser.

- [Latest release](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/releases/latest): Linux AppImage, Windows installer

## Source

- [crates/mostik-core](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/crates/mostik-core): domain model, markup parser, demo data
- [crates/mostik-yandex](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/crates/mostik-yandex): Telemost web client protocol
- [app/ui](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/app/ui): Leptos UI compiled to wasm; runs on demo data in a plain browser
- [app/src-tauri](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/app/src-tauri): Tauri 2 desktop shell
